description: Thirty failed password attempts against one account within two minutes
reason: Repeated login failures may indicate password guessing.
next_step: Check timestamps, targeted accounts, source IP, and successful logins.

description: An unusual shell command was executed by a user account
reason: Unusual shell execution may require investigation.
next_step: Review the command, user, parent process, and execution context.

description: PowerShell executed an encoded command that requires investigation
reason: Unusual PowerShell activity may indicate suspicious execution.
next_step: Review command-line details and the process that launched it.

description: An unexpected scheduled task appeared on a workstation
reason: Unexpected task creation may be used to execute code later.
next_step: Inspect the task, creator account, configured command, and timing.

description: An unfamiliar program was added to a startup location
reason: An unfamiliar startup entry may run a program automatically.
next_step: Inspect the entry, target file, creator, and file reputation.

description: An endpoint alert reported behavior consistent with process injection
reason: An endpoint alert reported behavior consistent with process injection.
next_step: Review endpoint telemetry and investigate the affected process.

description: An unfamiliar account was added to a privileged group
reason: An unexpected privileged-group change may alter account access.
next_step: Verify the account, group change, creator, and authorization.

description: Endpoint security protection was unexpectedly disabled
technique_name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
reason: Unexpectedly disabling security protection may reduce visibility.
next_step: Check who disabled it, when, and whether maintenance was approved.

description: A workstation generated repeated DNS requests to a suspicious-looking domain
reason: Unusual DNS requests may warrant command-and-control investigation.
next_step: Review queried domains, DNS answers, frequency, and destination traffic.

description: A workstation sent an unusually large amount of data to an external destination
reason: A large outbound transfer alone does not prove data theft.
next_step: Check destination, data type, volume, and business justification.

description: A large archive containing many sensitive-looking files was created unexpectedly
reason: Unexpected archiving of files may relate to data staging.
next_step: Inspect the archive, its contents, creator, and subsequent activity.

description: An unfamiliar system service was installed on a workstation
reason: An unfamiliar service may be used to run a program persistently.
next_step: Inspect service configuration, executable, creator, and timing.

description: A remote login occurred at an unusual time from an unfamiliar address
reason: An unusual remote login may warrant investigation.
next_step: Verify the user, source IP, authentication method, and expected schedule.

description: An employee reported an email containing a suspicious attachment
reason: A suspicious email may be an attempt to gain access through deception.
next_step: Examine sender details, links, attachments, and recipient exposure.

description: A workstation downloaded an executable from an untrusted-looking domain
reason: An unexpected executable download may involve tool transfer.
next_step: Check the URL, file hash, download process, and file reputation.

description: A monitored configuration file changed unexpectedly
reason: A file change alone does not identify an attacker technique.
next_step: Compare file hashes and review the change, user, and file history.

description: Failed login attempts targeted twelve different accounts from one source
reason: Failures across many accounts may warrant investigation for spraying.
next_step: Compare targeted accounts, timing, source IP, and password patterns.

description: A standard user process unexpectedly attempted a privileged operation
reason: An unusual privileged operation alone does not prove an attack.
next_step: Review process details, permissions, outcome, and related alerts.

description: An audit log was unexpectedly cleared or truncated
reason: Unexpected log clearing may indicate an attempt to remove evidence.
next_step: Check audit records, authorized maintenance, and logging gaps.

description: An unexpected remote service connection was observed between two workstations
reason: Unexpected connections between workstations may require investigation.
next_step: Identify the service, source and destination hosts, and authentication.
